summary: Phase 1 Programme Quality wiring verified. Backend: 11 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail on /app/backend/tests/test_iter59_programme_quality.py. /api/programme/current, /api/coach/clients/{id}/programme and /programme/history all return 200 with correct data. Retry-worker path (POST /api/roster/jobs/{job_id}/retry) fully wires programme_context_for_llm -> _generate_month -> validate_programme -> persist_programme_record; a programmes row is written with goal_key='general_fitness', phase.key='foundation', week_index=1, target_sessions_per_week=3, roster_id matching, validation_status set. Workout docs from this path carry source ('coaching_system'/'template'), needs_coach_review bool, variants={green:null,amber:null,red:null} stub, and non-empty LLM rationale. persist_programme_record is IDEMPOTENT on retry (1 row before / 1 row after, same id, only updated_at changed). Frontend /workout/[id] label now reads 'WHY THIS SESSION?' (screenshot confirmed) and no client-facing AI/LLM/bot wording found. GAP: /api/workouts/generate-month endpoint (line 4271) does not call validate_programme + persist_programme_record after its worker completes, so calling this endpoint alone does NOT populate the programmes collection (only /roster/upload-and-generate and /roster/jobs/{id}/retry do).

minor.issue: Background _worker() at server.py ~L4289 does not call validate_programme + persist_programme_record after workouts are upserted, unlike /roster/upload-and-generate (L2521-2543) and /roster/jobs/{id}/retry (L2776-2785). Task spec says either endpoint should populate the programmes collection. Recommend replicating the block: after `dates_now` cleanup, if programme_ctx is available (compute via programme_context_for_llm), fetch persisted_workouts and call validate_programme + persist_programme_record. Workout schema fields (source/needs_coach_review/variants) ARE correctly written by this endpoint — only the programme row persistence is missing.

issues: Console error x2 on load: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' — cosmetic React Native warning, likely a stray whitespace/space char inside a <View>. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Wire validate_programme + persist_programme_record into /api/workouts/generate-month background worker (server.py ~L4289-4360) so this endpoint also produces a programmes row, matching the roster-upload and retry-worker paths.
Investigate and fix the 'Unexpected text node' console warning on /workout/[id] (frontend/app/workout/[id]/index.tsx) — likely a stray whitespace character between JSX elements inside a View.
Optional: add a coach dashboard integration test that verifies validation_errors/warnings are surfaced (this iteration only asserted validation_status, not the presence of the tasks/alerts feed).
Consider seeding at least one template-fallback workout in a test fixture so TestTemplateFallbackSchema stops being skipped.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_programme_quality.persist_programme_record correctly upserts by (user_id, roster_id) — idempotency verified in test_idempotent_second_retry_no_duplicate.

programme_context_for_llm reuses week_index for a matching roster row (L204-214) so retries do not drift periodisation. Confirmed via retry test: same roster returned same phase='foundation', week_index=1.
Two endpoints (main roster worker + retry worker) both correctly compute programme_ctx once and pass it through. /workouts/generate-month is the only laggard.
server.py is ~7757 lines — exceeds the recommended 700-line ceiling; splitting workout/roster/coach concerns into modules would improve maintainability. Not blocking Phase 1.
